headline: Eagers Auto to Acquire Full Control of Australian BYD Joint Venture
summary: Eagers Auto shares surged after agreeing to acquire the remaining stake in its joint venture with Chinese EV maker BYD.
why: Eagers Auto is an Australian automotive retail dealership group operating across Australia and New Zealand.

impacts.name: Eagers Automotive
impacts.why: Shares surged after the company agreed to buy the remaining stake in its BYD joint venture.

why_moved: Eagers Auto shares jumped following news it would gain full ownership of its BYD distribution venture.
